setting: You both live in Lisbon, in the Graça neighbourhood, where you shared a flat until this spring. You were together for six years, and you split up a year ago. You know each other's habits, families and friends well, and you both know the cat, Pão, is the main reason you're still in contact. Your last exchange was small talk about the bakery on the corner changing its opening hours.

private_lines.Inês: You live alone in a small flat in Graça now and work as a freelance translator, mostly documents for a law firm. This week you have a tight deadline on a contract and a vet appointment for Pão on Thursday that you still need to pay for.
private_lines.Tiago: You live in a flat in Arroios and work as a sound engineer for a theatre company, which means evening shifts most of the week. This week you're rehearsing a new production and trying to get a bit of rest before the opening.

situation: My ex and I, sorting out who keeps the cat.

text: Tiago, can you take Pão this weekend? I have the contract deadline Wed and I can't have him under my feet while I work
Hey. Friday night I'm on till late, not sure about Saturday yet, rehearsal might run long
So that's a no for Friday
It's a maybe for Friday. Saturday's more likely. Can I let you know tomorrow
You said that about the shutters in March
Different thing. I'll sort the shutters
You'll sort them
😅 Yes
Also the vet bill from last Thursday came to 84,50. I've attached the receipts, the consult and the vaccine. Half is 42,25. Can you do the transfer this week
https://files.inesmatos.pt/recibos_pao_nov.pdf
Got them. The vaccine was 31 right? Not 36
The vaccine was 31. The consult was 53,50. Total 84,50. I did the sum before I sent it
Ok ok. Sorry, I'm just looking at the receipt on my phone and it's tiny
It's not tiny, it's a PDF
Transfer's going through tomorrow morning. Also I'll ask Rui about Saturday, he owes me a favour for the sound desk
Don't use Pão as a bargaining chip
Wouldn't dream of it
Did the transfer go through
Yes sorry, it went out at 8. Check your account
I see it. Thanks
Rui says he can do Saturday if I do his Sunday load-in. So Saturday is probably mine
Fine. Drop him off Saturday morning, not Friday night. He doesn't like the stairs when it's dark
And bring his food, the grey tin, not the pouch
Ok. Grey tin. Will he sleep at mine or do you want him back Sunday
Sunday afternoon. I have a walk planned Sunday morning and I want to take him, he'd hate being left
Sunday afternoon works. Can I keep him Saturday night if rehearsal finishes on time? Or is that a no
Saturday night is fine if you bring him back Sunday by 4. Not 4:40
Ha. 4. Promise
Grey tin, blue lid or green lid?
Grey tin, blue lid. Green is the chicken and he won't touch it
Ok. Got it
Did you message Rui
Yes. He says Sunday load-in is 9 so I'll be up early anyway. Could I drop Pão at 7 on Saturday
Ten. Not seven
You said morning
Ten is morning
Ok 10
Thursday I'm passing by the old flat to get my other boots. I'll look at the shutters while I'm there
You said that in March
I'm aware
Vet is Thursday 11:00. I'm taking him. You're not coming
Wasn't going to ask. Do you want me to pay the bit that's left after this week's transfer or is that separate
Separate. The bill's done, we split it, that's the end of it
Ok
Contract's submitted. Don't call me before Friday
Wasn't going to. Congratulations on not dying
Thank you
Found a Mingus pressing at the market in Campo de Ourique. Looks like you'd hate it
Everything you own looks like I'd hate it
Fair
